summary: Fixed the ledger package against docs/conventions.md (half-away rounding, negative formatting, rate lookup with 6-month lookback and no later months, rate file range import and column name, header-over-dialect layout, reversal booking/valuation by original, tax rule effective date, per-entry rounded totals, fiscal quarters, writer jurisdiction key, HTML total sign, returns by valuation quarter). All 755 tests pass; tools/audit.py has one remaining failure, in rule 6.2, because its check expects a 3-month lookback while conventions.md says 6 (MAX_LOOKBACK), so I followed the doc.
